lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the base plate to narrow upright flange fold, with an included angle of about 89 deg, on outer skins 2 and 4. Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the bisector point of the outer fillet. That point is 2.27 mm in from both the base-bottom plane and the flange-outer plane, which fits an outer radius of about 7.8 mm for t 3.88. Scan points sit 0.15-0.23 mm from the line at those three sections and 0.02-0.18 mm at stations every 2 mm along it. The fold exists only across the flange width: the flange outer face runs from t -0.16 to 16.82, about 17.0 mm, and a relief slot separates it from the main L body. The line runs t 0 to 16.57 and is parallel, so it covers about 97.6% of the fold.
